definitions.meaning: To go or pass away, perish

quotations.old_english: Fórneáh ǽlc tilþ on mersclande forferde
quotations.english: very nearly all the tilth in the marsh-land perished

source_text: for-feran; p. de; pp. ed [for-, feran to go] To go or pass away, perish; p&e-short;r&i-long;re :-- Fórneáh ǽlc tilþ on mersclande forferde very nearly all the tilth in the marsh-land perished, Chr. 1098; Erl. 235, 13.
